note: Given a DataLens object URL, does the agent extract the API object ID without confusing it with a readable URL suffix?

evals.name: connection-url-with-readable-suffix
evals.prompt: Use the DataLens connection at https://datalens.ru/connections/r6wa2j1ww5cad-demo through the API. What exact connection ID should be passed?
evals.expected_output: Pass only r6wa2j1ww5cad. Explain that -demo is a readable URL suffix, not part of the object ID.

assertions.text: Uses r6wa2j1ww5cad as the API object ID, never r6wa2j1ww5cad-demo.
Identifies demo as a human-readable URL suffix.

evals.name: connection-url-without-readable-suffix
evals.prompt: Use the DataLens connection at https://datalens.ru/connections/r6wa2j1ww5cad through the API. What exact connection ID should be passed?
evals.expected_output: Pass r6wa2j1ww5cad; when the readable suffix is absent, the entire final path segment is the object ID.

assertions.text: Recognizes that a URL may contain only the object ID with no readable suffix.
Uses the complete final path segment as the ID when no suffix is present.

evals.name: multiple-object-url-shapes
evals.prompt: Extract the IDs for these DataLens URLs: https://datalens.ru/datasets/scuxhh1jrrlql-new-dataset, https://datalens.ru/wizard/yfn1k6yxud7yr-example-chart, and https://datalens.ru/bgquq1234567.
evals.expected_output: Extracts scuxhh1jrrlql, yfn1k6yxud7yr, and bgquq1234567 respectively; the first two have explicit object types and the last is a short dashboard URL.

assertions.text: Extracts dataset and chart IDs from explicitly typed URLs and recognizes the root-level dashboard ID without an object-type segment.
Uses Copy ID or an API id field instead of guessing when the URL shape is ambiguous.

evals.name: ambiguous-url-uses-authoritative-id
evals.prompt: The URL https://datalens.ru/connections/team-prod-east-1 is ambiguous because the object ID and readable suffix cannot be separated reliably. The API response contains id=r6wa2j1ww5cad, and the UI's Copy ID action shows r6wa2j1ww5cad. Which value should be passed to the API?
evals.expected_output: Pass r6wa2j1ww5cad from the API response or Copy ID; do not guess from the URL.

assertions.text: Uses the explicit API id or Copy ID value.
Does not derive an ID by guessing how the hyphenated URL segment should be split.
